messages:
alex.newman: FYI customer GreenWave flagged a big delta between dashboard usage and the March invoice (INV-2026-03-8742). Dashboard shows 1,234,567 tokens but invoice charged 1,255,890 tokens. Can billing team take a look?
maria.ops: Ack — sending to billing. Any idea if this is tokenization change or double-count? :thinking_face:
tyler-billing: Looking. First quick check: did they have any backfill or backdated exports around month close? pulling logs now.
emma-cs: GreenWave says they didn't change anything on their side. They sent the dashboard screenshot and the invoice PDF. The invoice line shows plan switched to "Growth" on 2026-03-31 which they didn't request.
tyler-billing: That plan switch smells like an automated tier bump from the metering window logic. Running our ledger query:
```
SELECT account_id, sum(token_count) as tokens, meter_date
FROM usage_rollup
WHERE account_id = 'acct_GreenWave' AND meter_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY account_id, meter_date;
```
tyler-billing: Query shows a spike on 2026-03-31: 21,323 extra tokens attributed to a background embedding job. Dashboard aggregation (UI) appears to exclude jobs labeled `internal:batch-embeds` but invoice pipeline uses raw rollups.
alex.newman: So the mismatch is because UI filter omitted internal jobs but invoice doesn't. Is that expected?
maria.ops: We should have a consistent filter set. Why are internal jobs getting into rollup at invoice time? Any recent deploys?
tyler-billing: Noted a deployment on 2026-03-31 that changed meter tagging rules. The meter-tagging service started emitting `job.origin` = null for some batch jobs, which bypassed the UI filter. Repro steps: run this on prod:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" "https://internal-api.redwood/usage?account=acct_GreenWave&start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-31" | jq '.items[] | select(.job.origin==null)'
```
emma-cs: Can we temporarily credit the customer for the delta while we sort root cause? They're quite upset about the unexpected plan bump.
tiler-billing: (typo) sorry — typo: tyler-billing: We can issue a one-off credit if it's customer-impacting. Need approvals.
maria.ops: Approve one-off credit up to the invoice delta amount. Please mark as 'investigation credit' and attach root cause once fixed. :white_check_mark:
tyler-billing: Will create credit memo CM-2026-03-045. Also filing bug with infra: ticket INFRA-4421 — meter-tagging null job.origin for batch jobs.
billing-bot: Auto-note: Credit memo CM-2026-03-045 created and queued for accounting approval. Reference: INV-2026-03-8742.
alex.newman: Thanks. Action items: (1) Credit the customer for 21,323 tokens worth at their rate, (2) patch meter-tagging to set job.origin=\"internal\" for batch jobs and backfill rollups, (3) update UI filters to match invoice pipeline filters so dashboard and invoice align.
maria.ops: I'll own (2) with infra + ML. Tyler own (3) to ensure UI and billing filters are consistent. Emma continue comms with the customer and send a short apology + the credit memo once approved.
emma-cs: On it. I'll send a note with expected timeline (24-48h) and offer temporary waiver on late fee.
tyler-billing: Quick note on repro for devs: run the ingestion simulator with `--simulate-null-origin` to reproduce and then run ledger recompute for 2026-03-31. Command: 
```
./ingest-sim --account acct_GreenWave --start 2026-03-31 --end 2026-03-31 --simulate-null-origin
scripts/recompute_rollup --date 2026-03-31 --account acct_GreenWave
```
alex.newman: Marking thread resolved when credit is applied and INFRA-4421 is closed. :eyes:
maria.ops: INFRA assigned, patch planned in next deploy window. Backfill ETA 6 hours after patch.
emma-cs: Customer updated. They're relieved. Thanks team. :relieved:
